topic: Database access and frame data extraction
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on accessing facility frame data for analysis. Initially, [p1] requested importing the frames database into PostgreSQL to allow querying of new structures or setting up sandbox access. The decision was made to proceed with pulling the data into production (prod) environment if client visibility allowed.

[me] provided SQL queries demonstrating how to join `facility`, `company`, and `frame` tables, noting that the frame data is stored in a separate table containing JSON within its records. A second query example was given showing how to extract specific fields (`label`, `type`) from the JSON data using PostgreSQL operators.

Later, [p1] inquired whether dwell-time metrics on prod were calculated for trusted vendors or all sources; [me] confirmed that dwell-time is calculated across all sources and that sampling was not used for this metric.
decisions: Frame data will be pulled into the production database environment.
Dwell-time metrics are calculated using data from all sources, not just trusted vendors.
action_items: [me] to proceed with pulling the frame data into prod (if client visibility permits).
